aiModels.EMBEDDINGS_MODEL: Choose the embedding model that turns your documents into vectors. Larger models deliver better relevance but require a full reindex and higher ingestion cost.
aiModels.LANGCHAIN_MODEL_NAME: Primary chat model used by the assistant and API. Pick a fast model for support flows or a premium one for expert answers.
aiModels.SUMMARY_MODEL: Optional model that generates summaries during ingestion. Leave it blank if you don't want to pay for extra passes.
aiModels.KEYWORDS_MODEL: Model used to extract business keywords. Enable it when your search relies on semantic tags.
aiModels.NER_MODEL: Entity extraction model (people, contracts, accounts). Improves advanced filters but slows down ingestion.

rag.RETRIEVE_K: Final k after rerank. 3–5: targeted, short prompt, less noise; 6–8: good balance; 10+: useful for dispersed/open questions, more tokens. Tip: try 5–6 on structured reports, 8–10 on heterogeneous corpora.
rag.FETCH_K: Raw candidates before MMR. Ideally 2–3× Retrieve K (e.g., FETCH_K=10 if RETRIEVE_K=5). Bigger → MMR can diversify better, with slight DB latency cost.
rag.MMR_LAMBDA: 0.7–0.9: pure relevance (risk redundancy); 0.4–0.6: balance (default 0.5); 0.2–0.3: high diversity if one doc dominates. Try ~0.4 if cache/retrieval over-selects the same doc.
rag.MAX_CHUNK_SIZE: Max chunk size in tokens for embedding. 800–1200 = fine recall but more vectors/cost; 1500+ = fewer entries but higher noise risk. Changing requires re-embedding existing docs (new-only would be inconsistent).
rag.MAX_LLM_TOKENS: Token budget for prompt + answer. Lower to reduce cost/latency; higher to allow longer citations and detailed answers. Align with your model and SLA.
rag.MAX_WORKERS: Parallel ingestion workers. Higher speeds up imports but uses more CPU/RAM and embedding calls. Mostly impacts future ingestions (existing docs stay as-is).

docling.DOC_OCR: Enables OCR on scanned pages so the text becomes searchable. Roughly doubles ingestion time.
docling.DOC_TABLE_STRUCTURE: Keeps the structure of tables (columns, headers). Ideal for HR/Finance and adds about 20% processing time.
docling.DOC_PICTURE_DESCRIPTION: Generates a text description for each image. Activate only for highly visual workflows.
docling.DOC_PICTURE_CLASSIFICATION: Assigns a category to images (logo, diagram, photo) to speed up filters. Requires a dedicated vision service.
docling.DOC_FORMULA_ENRICHMENT: Recognizes and rewrites scientific formulas. Enable only for technical corpora.
docling.DOC_GENERATE_PAGE_IMAGES: Produces page thumbnails. Required for OCR and to preview pages in the console.
docling.MAX_CHUNK_SIZE: Max chunk size before embedding (impacts vector count). 800–1200 = fine recall but more vectors/cost; 1500+ = fewer entries but higher noise risk. Existing docs are not automatically re-embedded.
docling.MAX_WORKERS: Number of parallel ingestions. Higher = faster imports, but more CPU/RAM and embedding calls. Change: restarting the ingestion service is recommended.
docling.BATCH_MAX_FILES: Recommended UI limit for the number of files per batch. Not enforced at this stage (dev phase).
docling.BATCH_MAX_FILE_MB: Recommended UI size per file for batch ingestion. Not enforced at this stage (dev phase).
docling.BATCH_MAX_TOTAL_MB: Recommended UI total size per batch. Not enforced at this stage (dev phase).
docling.OCR_REPROCESS_LAYOUT_THRESHOLD: Threshold (0-1) that triggers an OCR rerun to fix layout issues. Lower it for noisy PDFs.
docling.OCR_REPROCESS_LOW_THRESHOLD: Overall quality threshold before re-running OCR. Lower = higher accuracy, higher = faster ingestion.
docling.OCR_REPROCESS_PARSE_THRESHOLD: Parsing acceptance threshold. Reduce it if you can handle more manual clean-up.
docling.KEYWORDS_MODE: Choose when keywords are extracted: disabled, pass0 or both (text + OCR). "Both" significantly increases processing time.
docling.KEYWORDS_TOPK: Maximum number of keywords per document (5-50). Increase for more granularity, decrease to limit cost.
docling.KEYWORDS_MINLEN: Minimum keyword length (characters). Raise it to filter very short acronyms.

assistant.FEEDBACK_REQUIRED: Force users to give Yes/No feedback after each assistant answer. Useful during testing to measure quality.
assistant.ASSISTANT_SYSTEM_PROMPT: System prompt used by the assistant. Customize tone, style or structure of the answers.
